name: Reuse sprint task creation in kanabn board task creation
description:
1. Started by adding board-name display to the desktop `Tab` via live app params, syncing app info when the active board changed.
2. Explained `SprintBoardView` needed no changes because `KanbanBoardView` owns the active board and is the single sync point.
3. Diagnosed the reload bug: `updateAppParams` replaced the app object, so dockview panels kept a stale reference and persisted the wrong board.
4. Fixed `ui.js` to mutate app params in place, sync panel params, and persist layout; reworked `KanbanBoardView` to snapshot/apply the requested board and avoid clobbering it.
5. Result: each of the two open panels restores its own board on reload, and runtime board switches update the app info correctly.

messages.content: Why  SprintBoardView has not been updated?

Good question — let me verify the actual wiring before answering, so I don't assume.
```
Search completed: 5 queries executed, 50 documents found
```
## Short answer

`SprintBoardView.vue` was **intentionally not changed** — it would have been redundant. It's a *child* presentation component that doesn't own the board state, doesn't see the app params/tabId, and never publishes anything itself. The single sync point (`KanbanBoardView`) already covers it.

## Why (verified against the code)

The relevant pieces I confirmed:

**1. `KanbanBoardView.vue` is the owner of the active board** — `activeBoardId` lives there (in `data`, not the store, so multiple panels can coexist):

```vue src/components/kanban/board/KanbanBoardView.vue
<!-- Sprint board is rendered by the SAME container -->
<SprintBoardView
  v-if="isSprintBoard && activeView === 'board'"
  :boardId="activeBoardId"
  @select-board="onSelectBoard"
/>
```

**2. `SprintBoardView.vue` is a pure child** — it only takes `boardId` and delegates every switch back up:

```vue src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardView.vue
props: {
  boardId: { type: String, default: null }
},
methods: {
  onSelectSprint(boardId) {
    // The active board lives in the parent component — ask it to switch
    this.$emit('select-board', boardId)
  }
}
```

**3. It has no access to the app params / tabId** — `appTabId` and `syncAppInfo()` only exist in the parent, because only the parent receives the full `params` payload (`params.app.tabId`) from the dockview panel.

**4. All sprint board switches already flow through the parent**, so `syncAppInfo()` fires anyway:

```txt flow
SprintBoardView.onSelectSprint(boardId)
  → $emit('select-board', boardId)
    → KanbanBoardView.onSelectBoard(boardId)  // owns activeBoardId
      → watch.activeBoard(board)
        → syncAppInfo()  // publishes { board, boardName } to openApps[tabId].params
          → Tab.vue reads live app → shows board name
```

Because the watcher is on the **parent's** `activeBoard`, the app-info update is triggered whether the switch comes from the kanban sidebar, the board list, or the sprint header dropdown inside `SprintBoardView`.

## What would changing it have cost?

| Concern | Result if we duplicated sync into `SprintBoardView` |
| :--- | :--- |
| Tab id access | Would need `appTabId` **plumbed down as a new prop** (parent → child) |
| Ownership | Two components publishing the same app info → **duplicate/conflicting writes** |
| Params board resolution | Already handled by the parent's `created()` + `boards` watcher; child inherits via the `boardId` prop |
| Value added | **None** — the parent's `activeBoard.title` is the exact source used for `boardName` |

## The one caveat worth stating

This holds **only because `SprintBoardView` is never mounted outside `KanbanBoardView`**. I verified this — there is no route or app definition that instantiates `SprintBoardView` directly (it lives under `src/components/kanban/board/` and is imported only by `KanbanBoardView.vue`). If it were ever used standalone, it *would* need its own `appTabId` + `syncAppInfo`.

## Recommendation

Leave it as is. The parent-owned sync is the correct single-responsibility design: **one owner of the active board, one place that publishes it.** If you'd prefer `SprintBoardView` to be self-sufficient, the clean change would be to pass `:appTabId="appTabId"` down and move `syncAppInfo` into a small composable both views share — but that's extra plumbing with no behavioural gain today.
